name: 48835 · Fowler, MI
findings: ZIP 48835 (Fowler) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48835 (Fowler) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
58% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
